# GdayMeetings 0.3.4

Audio Files now provides native Payload file uploads. Select or drag in a recording; Gday stores the file and generates its filename, size and content type automatically. Desktop uploads use the same CMS-managed file collection. Deleting a record deletes its file.

Existing recordings migrate in place on SQLite and PostgreSQL, preserving signed audio URLs. Back up the database and persistent audio volume before upgrading. Keep /app/data mounted. File replacement is disabled to preserve existing task inputs; upload a new recording instead.

Container: ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.3.4 (Linux AMD64 and ARM64). The latest tag is updated by the release workflow.

Uploads are capped at 500 MB (500,000,000 bytes), across both CMS and desktop paths. Opus, M4A and MP3 are recommended; WAV remains supported. MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES can lower the limit, but values above 500000000 are rejected.

Fixes the non-root container temporary upload directory. Release images must now pass a real CMS upload/download/deletion smoke test before version and latest tags are published. Use 0.3.4 or later for CMS uploads.

The image index contains only linux/amd64 and linux/arm64; BuildKit attestation manifests (displayed as unknown/unknown) are disabled.
